title: Greensboro Sit-In
author: Abby Kreines, Sara Tanzer, and Becca Moura
description: James begins to speak "Fellow students, we are all gathered here because we are all working for the same cause. Equal rights. Our people have been oppressed for too long! It is up to us, the youth, to take action. We have two choices, we can take example from Dr. Martin Luther King and conduct a peaceful protest, such as a sit-in. Or we can riot. Think wisely of the pros and cons of each type of protest...
